"Yeh Reshmi Zulfen" is a classic romantic song from the Bollywood film Do Raaste (1969), sung by the legendary Mohammed Rafi. The film starred Rajesh Khanna and Mumtaz, two of the most popular actors of the time. The music for this song was composed by Laxmikant-Pyarelal, and the lyrics were written by Anand Bakshi.
